_about: B4.2 — reviewed decisions on the ExerciseDB import, keyed by the source name (lowercase). formaId: the curated Forma item this is the SAME movement as (null = not the same). variantOf: the item this is a variation of (kept separate). They override the automatic matching in import-exercisedb.mjs.

star jump.note: an explosive jump, not a jumping jack

cable kickback.note: a TRICEPS kickback on the cable (the Forma cable kickback is the glute one)

farmers walk.note: same movement; ExerciseDB tags it quads, Forma forearms/traps/abs

flutter kicks.note: same movement; ExerciseDB tags it glutes, Forma abs/hip flexors

cable lat pulldown full range of motion.note: a standing two-pulley pull, NOT the seated lat pulldown — never linked to fx_lat_pulldown
